title: Workspace UX, Nine Custom PERPs, Line Close-Only Magnet and Radar Cleanup
changes: Add per-symbol checkboxes, select-all and confirmed batch deletion for stored R2 drawings.
Increase custom Pionex PERP list to nine; Worker workspace validation updated to accept nine across devices.
CTRL magnetic snapping in line display mode attaches ONLY to the nearest candle close (C); OHLC in K mode remains unchanged.
Add CoinMarketCap external Direct Link beside CMC fear/greed API retry.
Prune deleted custom symbols from persisted radar events and hide non-event observation section.
Only show all-four-charts-locked warning when four charts are truly open and locked.
requiredDeploy: First deploy cloudflare/worker.js to existing Worker (nine custom symbols validation).
Then overwrite listed MultiAssetLiquidityRadar frontend files via GitHub Pages.
